decisions.reason: Metro data-centre connectivity sits squarely in the firm's strategic cloud and infrastructure direction, and with evidence of early adoption the option now looks valuable enough to retain.
Optical spectrum connectivity leverages owned fibre assets and serves high-bandwidth enterprise demand, so management would keep it as a strategically aligned offering rather than abandon it.
The voice number ordering portal is tied to the installed voice business and is relatively inexpensive to maintain, so the firm would keep the option open despite only moderate growth prospects.
After several years, uncertainty around this voice-focused service is likely resolved enough to show limited upside versus better uses of resources in data, cloud and software-defined connectivity.
